# ValheimTesting

> Reusable test inputs, fixtures and assertions for Valheim mods: unit tests against game doubles with no game, and disposable native checks that drive a real dedicated server and client.

ValheimTesting serves mod authors and the coding agents that work in their mod repositories. A mod's tests live in the mod's own repository and use the published NuGet packages and the `valheim-test` tool; testing a mod needs none of this repository's source. To change the toolkit itself, start at AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md. The documentation site is https://tvongaza.github.io/ValheimTesting/.

## Start

- [Get started](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): add a test project to a mod, pin the packages and run the first test
- [Choose a test layer](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/guides/choose-a-test-layer.md): which layer tests which behaviour, and what each layer cannot prove
- [Your first server load check](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/tutorials/first-server-load-check.md): `env preflight`, `server-load` and `env status` on one Windows PC
- [Package versions](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/package-versions.md): every package, its version and the pins to copy
- [Examples](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/examples/README.md): runnable examples, from the first unit test to a native session

## Guides

- [Test logic that uses game types](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/guides/test-logic-that-uses-game-types.md): source-link mod code and test it against the game doubles
- [Test terrain decisions](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/guides/test-terrain-decisions.md): heights, slopes, biomes and zone seams without the game
- [Run tests in CI](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/guides/run-tests-in-ci.md): run a mod's tests in GitHub Actions
- [Check that a mod loads](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/guides/check-a-mod-loads.md): `valheim-test server-load`, `start` and `server-load-ab`
- [Before a native run](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/guides/before-a-native-run.md): check the machine, the mod and the evidence rules before starting the game
- [Debug a native run](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/guides/debug-a-native-run.md): read a refused or failed run, inspect a held run, clean up with `env status` and `env recover`
- [Test save, restart and rejoin](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/guides/test-save-restart-rejoin.md): a dedicated server and a client through a save, a restart and a rejoin
- [Run an A/B regression](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/guides/run-an-ab-regression.md): one mod before and after a change
- [Run on another machine](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/guides/run-on-another-machine.md): servers and clients on SSH or container hosts
- [Run a session with several clients](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/guides/run-a-session-with-several-clients.md): campaigns with named clients on several machines
- [Profiles and hosts](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/concepts/profiles-and-hosts.md): how a run stages a disposable profile over the install, on this machine or a host

## Reference

- [valheim-test](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/packages/Valheim.Testing.NativeSmoke.md): every command and option of the tool
- [Valheim.Testing](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/packages/Valheim.Testing.md): declared terrain, grid dumps, rendering and static overrides
- [Valheim.Testing.Doubles](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/packages/Valheim.Testing.Doubles.md): source-only doubles of the Unity, Valheim, BepInEx and Jotunn types
- [Valheim.Testing.Game](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/packages/Valheim.Testing.Game.md): one game process from outside, its pins, observations and reports
- [Valheim.Testing.GameSessions](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/packages/Valheim.Testing.GameSessions.md): a server and clients as one run, on this PC or other machines
- [Valheim.Testing.Adapter](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/packages/Valheim.Testing.Adapter.md): source for a mod's game-side test adapter plugin
- [Valheim.Testing.Bindings](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/packages/Valheim.Testing.Bindings.md): check offline that a built mod's game references still bind
- [Evidence](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/reference/evidence.md): what a native run's `result.json` links to
- [Log scan](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/reference/game-log-scan.md): the log patterns that fail a run at teardown
- [Platforms](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/reference/platforms.md): which host runs which role
- [API reference](https://tvongaza.github.io/ValheimTesting/reference/): every public type, generated from source

## Agents

- [Agent workflow](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/agent-guide.md): the task table, the loop, how to read results, the report and where problems go
- [Skill](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/.agents/skills/valheim-mod-testing/SKILL.md): the valheim-mod-testing skill to copy into a mod repository
- [Give your coding agent the workflow](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/docs/guides/give-your-agent-the-workflow.md): install the skill and write the mod's AGENTS.md
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/AGENTS.md): for agents changing ValheimTesting itself

## Optional

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/tvongaza/ValheimTesting/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): repository ownership, local validation and pull requests
